title: The Silent Hollow Revisited
author: Gideon Dunmore
blurb: Dominic Brightwater, a bone-carver who hears the dead, has never left the valley where magic cannot follow. Then a child arrives at the door speaking a language that predates kingdoms — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must carry a secret that could reignite an ancient war before the moon completes its thirteenth turn.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
